integrity: Analytical proof and finite reproducibility checker supplied; originality is qualified by possible implicit equivalences in inverse moment literature. No independent audit or noisy-data validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact population mean times and final approach-side probabilities; no finite-sample/noisy-data stability is claimed.
Known circumference, diffusivity, initial position, and target side; iid instantaneous Poisson resets to a rate-independent law.
Excludes resetting onto the target, drift, delayed returns, rate-dependent sources and correlated clocks.
Classical Prony and positive Hankel moment methods are credited as pre-existing mathematical ingredients.
title: Sharp finite-rate two-channel tomography for sparse Brownian resetting on a ring
